subcategory_text: Review the architecture periodically against the security requirements, threat models, and reference architecture.
implementation_examples: L1: Ad-hoc architecture review by AppSec team
L2: Scheduled review with documented checklists
L3: Architecture delta reviews per change, with cross-team sign-off
assessment_objectives: Determine whether architecture reviews occur on a defined cadence.
Determine whether findings feed back into design improvements.
